name: Registry::open

test_list.description: Go/no-go gate: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE ... USING fts5(..., tokenize='trigram') works in the bundled SQLite and finds a mid-word substring.
open creates the directory and registry.db in WAL mode at the current schema version.
open_connection sets foreign_keys=ON, synchronous=NORMAL and the configured busy_timeout.
Dropping the handle and opening the directory again keeps sessions and indexed history.
A registry under `dir with space/événements` opens, writes and reads.
Two Registry handles on the same directory (WAL) see each other's committed writes.
Four reader threads query while a writer indexes messages through other handles; nothing fails.
While another connection holds the write lock a write returns Busy (transient) after the bounded retries, and succeeds once the lock is released.
A registry.db that is not a SQLite database is refused with a Fatal-kind error and is not overwritten.
Registry can be shared across threads and async tasks.
Busy is Transient, SchemaTooNew and Corrupt are Fatal, BadValue is Permanent.

inputs.name: dir
inputs.description: Directory that holds registry.db (created if missing).

output_description: Handle owning a dedicated database thread; WAL, busy timeout and migrations are applied before it is returned.
